title: Global Existence of Weak Solutions for Non-Linear Partial Differential Equations
abstract: We prove global existence of weak solutions for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.

sections.heading: 1. Function Spaces and Weak Derivatives
sections.text:
Definition 1.6. A function u in L^2(Omega) has weak derivative v = d^alpha u if integral u D^alpha phi = (-1)^{|alpha|} integral v phi for all smooth test functions phi.
Example 4. The absolute value function u(x) = |x| has weak derivative sgn(x).

sections.heading: 2. Existence Theorem
sections.text:
Lemma 2.6. Sobolev embedding H^1(R^3) embedded into L^6(R^3) is continuous.
Theorem 8.1. Theorem 8.1 follows from Lemma 2.6. For any initial velocity u_0 in L^2(R^3), there exists a global weak solution u(t,x) to the Navier-Stokes equations.
Proof of Theorem 8.1. Using Definition 1.6 and Lemma 2.6, we construct energy bounds via Galerkin approximations.
Corollary 8.2. By Theorem 8.1, the energy inequality integral |u(t)|^2 dx <= integral |u_0|^2 dx holds for almost all t.
